# NvpwrControl 2.4.2 beta — adaptive UI fix

- Power page now expands with the real window width instead of remaining near the original 1220px design width.
- Two-column pages automatically collapse to one column on narrower usable widths.
- Power sliders are forced to the actual card client width, preventing the right side of the range from being clipped.
- Slider shows the selected wattage under the thumb plus visible minimum/maximum labels.
- Selected MAX/CURRENT labels stay pinned inside the right edge of the card.
- Existing resolver, MAX/CURRENT backend, telemetry, tuning and icon are unchanged.
